# zerops_service_subdomain_access (Resource)

Enables Zerops-generated HTTP subdomains for an already deployed service. Declare an explicit dependency on the deployment that defines HTTP ports. Disabling access does not stop the service.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    zerops = { source = "zeropsio/zerops" }
  }
}

provider "zerops" {}

variable "service_id" {
  type        = string
  description = "Existing runtime service ID."
}

resource "zerops_service_deploy" "app" {
  service_id   = var.service_id
  archive_path = "${path.module}/app.tar.gz"
  zerops_yaml  = file("${path.module}/zerops.yml")
  setup        = "app"
}

# The deployment must declare an HTTP port (for example TCP/HTTP 3000).
# A service_id reference alone does not establish deployment ordering.
resource "zerops_service_subdomain_access" "app" {
  service_id = var.service_id
  depends_on = [zerops_service_deploy.app]
}

output "urls" {
  value = zerops_service_subdomain_access.app.urls
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `service_id` (String) Service to expose. Its deployment must declare HTTP ports. Only one access resource may own a service.

### Optional

- `timeouts` (Block, Optional) Operation timeouts. One timeout covers lock acquisition, API requests, queued work and readiness polling. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Service ID; identical to `service_id`.
- `urls` (Set of String) HTTPS URLs read from non-editable generated project routes targeting this service. No hostnames are guessed.

<a id="nestedblock--timeouts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `timeouts`

Optional:

- `create` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).
- `delete` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours). Setting a timeout for a Delete operation is only applicable if changes are saved into state before the destroy operation occurs.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Access must already be enabled; import uses the service ID, not a route ID.
terraform import zerops_service_subdomain_access.app "$SERVICE_ID"
```
